name: Niji no Arika
source:
Hero graduates from high school at his home town and goes to Tokyo to realize his dream. However, he fails at that and has to return back to his home town. There he meets old acquaintances and discovers places and people he never knew.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/12/vn-of-month-march-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
英雄在家乡高中毕业，前往东京实现自己的梦想。然而，他未能如愿，不得不返回家乡。在那里，他遇到了老熟人，发现了他从未认识的地方和人。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/12/vn-of-month-march-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
